comments.author: participant3
comments.body:
> can we have detailed analysis about the reason before the close the issue?

1. based on the client logs. most of all request got timeout and throw a `Deadline Exceeded` Error
2. client send the request to proxy, start from`'RPC start': '2023-07-12 20:40:49.816654'`, end with `debug_error_string = "UNKNOWN:Error received from peer ipv4:10.255.242.4:19530 {created_time:"2023-07-12T20:41:49.859728042+00:00", grpc_status:4, grpc_message:"Deadline Exceeded"}"` which means after the 60s timeout, the client didn't received the response, so client throw a `Deadline Exceeded`
3. during the whole search process, the client send 840 search requests, and the proxy only received 87 request. **which means that most of the search requests does't arrived at proxy before timeout**
![image](https://github.com/milvus-io/milvus/assets/108661493/ac1f9f0b-fb97-4a14-a9c9-97c1aed30ee7)

conclusion:
client send search request and timeout, but proxy doesn't receive those requests. maybe there exist some `network problems` between client and proxy. we also found that the client has a high cpu usage warning`WARNING - fouram]: CPU usage above 90%! This may constrain your throughput and may even give inconsistent response time measurements!`, which may also affected.  

by the way:
int other test cases, we also found same timeout Error, which is due to  query node consume mq too slow. then search will stuck at `wait tSafe` for about 50s, which has same behavior on client,  lots of `Deadline Exceeded`
